Container.Name: riffle-server
Container.Overview: Companion server for the Riffle iOS player. Indexes your video folders, streams the original files with byte-range support (no transcoding), and pre-renders trickplay sheets so scrubbing previews are instant. Thumbnails are decoded on the NVIDIA GPU (Nvidia Driver plugin), the Intel iGPU, or the CPU. Keep App data on the SSD pool and mount media read-only.
Container.Requires: The Nvidia Driver plugin, for NVIDIA thumbnail decoding (optional: the server falls back to the CPU).

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: API, streaming and the admin dashboard (/admin/).

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Index, progress and thumbnail cache. Put it on the SSD pool so thumbnails stay fast while array disks are spun down.

Config.Name: Movies
Config.Description: A media share, mounted read-only. Listed in Folders as Movies=/media/movies.

Config.Name: TV
Config.Description: A media share, mounted read-only. Listed in Folders as TV=/media/tv. Add more paths the same way and list each in Folders.

Config.Name: Folders
Config.Description: The folders to index and the names the app shows: Name=/container/path, separated by commas.

Config.Name: Token
Config.Description: Shared secret the app and dashboard send. Empty leaves the API open to anyone on your network.

Config.Name: Thumbnail decoder
Config.Description: cuda for NVIDIA (needs the runtime in Extra Parameters), vaapi for the Intel iGPU (needs the device below), none for the CPU.

Config.Name: NVIDIA visible devices
Config.Description: Which GPUs the container sees: all, or a GPU UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin page.

Config.Name: Intel iGPU
Config.Description: Set to /dev/dri to decode thumbnails on the Intel iGPU (Thumbnail decoder: vaapi).

Config.Name: Thumbnail interval
Config.Description: Seconds between scrub thumbnails (short clips get finer spacing).

Config.Name: Thumbnail workers
Config.Description: Concurrent thumbnail jobs. Keep at 1 for the HDD array.

Config.Name: Accurate thumbnails
Config.Description: true decodes every frame for exact thumbnails (much slower); false uses keyframes.
